commands.name: simple
commands.description: Turn Clean View on or off

tools.name: plan_steps
tools.description: Lay out every step of the job up front, before any other tool: 2 to 8 short plain-English step names, in order, each under 40 characters and starting with a verb. No file names, paths, commands or code. The first step starts right away.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Report progress on the current step, by its name from plan_steps, as real progress happens. Send percent 100 the moment a step finishes; the next step then starts. A name not in the plan becomes a new step.
